finding_1_shorts_dominate_all_regimes.description: Shorts outperform longs in BOTH bull and bear markets

finding_2_fading_funding_works_universal.description: Fading funding direction works in both regimes - this is the core alpha

finding_3_zscore_velocity_7d_is_stronges.description: 7d z-score velocity is the strongest single predictor. Peaking z-scores (fading) produce 13.5x more total PnL than building z-scores

finding_4_contrarian_tokens_in_bull_alig.action: SKIP these trades (save $350K) or FLIP direction (gain $700K estimated)

finding_5_best_bucket.description: Contrarian tokens going SHORT in a BTC bull market is the best bucket. Classic 'fade the overextended alt long' trade.

do_NOT_flip_follow_candidates.reason: Flipping score<=-2 trades LOSES $1.08M. The strategy is net profitable on almost all buckets. The crowd-following direction is NOT better overall.
do_NOT_flip_follow_candidates.exception: BULL/Aligned/contrarian longs are the ONE bucket to skip or flip

primary_filter.description: Use 7d z-score velocity as the primary entry filter
primary_filter.rule: Only enter when dz_7d < 0 (z-score peaking/declining). Skip entries where dz_7d > 0 (z still building).
primary_filter.estimated_impact: Drop 766 marginal trades ($186 avg), keep 649 high-quality trades ($2,975 avg). Net PnL preserved at $1.93M with 47% fewer trades.

secondary_filter.description: In BTC bull regime, skip contrarian-token longs
secondary_filter.rule: If BTC > SMA50 AND token is contrarian-configured AND signal says go long, SKIP the trade.

tertiary_filter.rule: When trade direction opposes funding rate direction, prioritize the trade. When aligned with funding, reduce size or skip.
tertiary_filter.note: Fading funding: WR=0.449 Avg=$2,692. Following funding: WR=0.325 Avg=-$47.

recommendation.overall_answer: FADE the crowd is correct ~85% of the time. Do NOT switch to following. But USE z-score velocity to TIME the fade: wait for the crowd's conviction to peak (dz_7d < 0) before entering the contrarian trade. The 60% higher peak profit of 'following' is a mirage from a small subset of trend trades; the fading approach has a massive WR and avg PnL advantage in the data.
